name: example-boundary-demo
description: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE ONLY - not a recommendation. Values are chosen to straddle the observed soak plateaus so the tool's behaviour is visible; they are derived from no limit or safety analysis. One VRAM warning at 80 C, instantaneous. GPU 1's VRAM hovers at 80-84 C in decode, so this sits on a boundary. Run with --compare-persistence to compare instantaneous and persistent behaviour directly.
